policy.source: frozen C_R1 B_POOL causal train rollouts
policy.history_write: Only frame % 8 == 0, after the current sample has read strictly earlier snapshots
policy.query_samples: All stored source samples; omit from training only when B output has no exact candidate representation
policy.association: Mutual unique member-ID association; ID 0 is a local branch, not target identity
policy.supervision: candidate IoU minus B output IoU; annotated absent candidates and B both have utility zero
policy.sampling: Uniform among valid stored samples; no former class balancing
policy.duplicate_default: Prefer a matching candidate containing local member 0, otherwise the first exact candidate
policy.source_features: Referenced directly; no model inference or feature copying to disk
